verifications.claim: Graco is recalling specific SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seat bases as of April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'April 6, 2026... Graco is recalling... SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seats after discovering a structural defect in the seat’s base'; R2: 'issue involves the base of the Snug-Ride Turn and Slide infant car seats'; R4: 'recalling some of its Snug-Ride Turn and Slide infant car seats after discovering an issue with the base'
verifications.reasoning: References directly confirm recall of SnugRide Turn & Slide car seat bases announced in April 2026.

verifications.claim: The recall is due to a structural defect discovered during post-production testing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'structural defect in the seat’s base during post‑production testing'; R2: '“a structural issue” during post-production testing'; R4: 'structural issue during post-production testing'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant references directly state the reason as a structural defect/issue found in post-production testing.

verifications.claim: Affected models were sold between January and March 2026 at major retailers, including Amazon, Target, and Walmart.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'sold between January and March at major retailers including Amazon, Target and Walmart'; R2: 'sold at Amazon... Target, Walmart'; R4: 'sold between January and March at Amazon, Target and Walmart'
verifications.reasoning: References directly confirm sales period and listed retailers for affected models.

verifications.claim: Affected products model is SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seats.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seats'; R2: 'Snug-Ride Turn and Slide infant car seats'; R4: 'SnugRide Turn and Slide infant car seats'
verifications.reasoning: References directly identify the affected model as SnugRide Turn & Slide infant car seats.

verifications.claim: Manufacture dates of affected products are January 2026 – March 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'select models sold between January and March'; R4: 'impacts models sold between January and March'
verifications.reasoning: References attribute January–March 2026 dates to sales period of affected products, not manufacture dates; manufacture date is mentioned separately on labels but no range provided.

verifications.claim: Model number and serial number are on the white sticker on the base.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'photograph the label on the base showing the model number... and serial number'; R4: 'Photo of the product label on the base showing the model number... and the serial number'
verifications.reasoning: References confirm model number and serial number on label/sticker on the base, but do not specify it is white.

verifications.claim: Graco Consumer Services contact number is 1-800-345-4109.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'contact our consumer services team at 1-800-345-4109'; 'Graco toll-free at 800-345-4109'
